biography.bio:
A professional race driver and the team's best behind the wheel; she reads a track like a book.

Masks: Aura, New Collider (wearing Aura).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.v16r33PnAhRjnK3S]{Shark}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.mRF2h6C2aEVaLlVL]{Stiletto}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.QGUAroPuJx1Ugrre]{Stiletto Plane}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Wraps the wearer in a force shield that drinks in the energy of incoming attacks.

Gloria Baker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Force Shield (a Move action): +3 Toughness and +1 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Slams a target with a concussive impact - and throws out a holographic double of the wearer.

Gloria Baker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.

system.description:
You are first off the line. While you are aboard a vehicle, your Initiative Tests are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: while you crew a vehicle, Initiative Tests are upshifted once.
